design: support-complete COMPOSITIONAL ring grow/delete (defines the support) + data-derived frequent-ring MACROS (acceleration cache only). The finite catalog must NOT define ring-generation support.
section1_supported_claim: Within the declared state space (broad-organic atom/bond vocab, max_atoms=40, charge-preserving, no stereo/isotope/radical), the operator system supports construction+deletion of any ring topology -- isolated/macrocycle/aromatic/saturated/heterocycle/fused/spiro/bridged/polycyclic -- whenever the successor satisfies executor legality. Topological support completeness is separated from empirical chemically-valid path coverage.

section2_primitives_exist.cycle_close: BondInsert(a,b,order) -- adds a bond between two existing atoms (operators.py:36; rule 'bond_insert' kernel.py:110; is_valid_bond_insert/apply_bond_insert).
section2_primitives_exist.cycle_open: BondDelete(a,b) -- removes a bond (operators.py:43; rule 'bond_delete' kernel.py:111).
section2_primitives_exist.gap: bond_insert/bond_delete exist in the EXECUTOR + general fiber but are NOT in MARK_RULE_NAMES, so the factorized model cannot score/propose them. The redesign wires cycle_close/cycle_open as factorized families (heads + enumeration + supervision).

section3_support_completeness_verified.method: for 400 real broad-organic <=40 molecules with rings: open every non-spanning-tree edge (cycle_open) to a spanning tree, then close every edge back (cycle_close), through the production executor.
section3_support_completeness_verified.verdict: COMPOSITIONAL support-completeness holds at the executor level for all observed ring topologies -- no whole-ring template is required for support.

supervision_implication: The verified open/close decomposition IS the cycle_close/cycle_open teacher signal (every ring bond in the corpus, round-trip verified). So the compositional operators get massive, easy supervision -- unlike the whole-ring template catalog. Multiple valid decompositions per molecule avoid learning one arbitrary ring basis (section-9).

P1_family_design.decision: REPURPOSE the two DEAD family slots cycle_insert -> cycle_close (bond_insert primitive) and cycle_attach -> cycle_open (bond_delete primitive), instead of adding new families. family_head stays Linear(hidden,10) -> NO width change -> warm-start family_head is preserved (the dead slots were never a teacher target). ring_system_grow/ring_system_delete remain as the MACRO families (simplified canonical-ring-graph identity, section-8 cache). Optional ear/spiro macros reuse ring_ear_insert etc.
P1_family_design.still_needs: new action-scoring heads (cycle_close: pair-score two same-component nonbonded atoms x bond order; cycle_open: score non-bridge cycle edges), fiber enumeration of both, the GM-loss _selected_mark_log_probability path, enable flags, and the simplified ring_system_grow macro key. This is an audited-model change (authorized).

remaining_phases.P1_model_wiring: repurpose the dead cycle_insert/cycle_attach slots -> cycle_close/cycle_open; add their factorized heads (pair-score for close, cycle-edge-score for open) + fiber enumeration + GM loss path. Uses the existing executor primitives; family_head width unchanged.
remaining_phases.P2_macros: structured ear/path insertion (2-anchor), spiro attachment (1-anchor), bond-only close, inverse deletes (section-4) as compositional shortcuts with exact canonical successors.
remaining_phases.P3_supervision: decompose real cyclic molecules into open/close (and ear/spiro macro) trajectories, both directions, multiple decompositions, scaffold-split (section-9).
remaining_phases.P4_macro_cache: the K~64 canonical-ring-graph macros as acceleration; a ring absent from macros stays reachable compositionally; aggregate macro+compositional mass on the same canonical successor (section-8).
remaining_phases.P5_calibration_gate: two-level ring-mass calibration (section-10); subtype/topology/template supervision gate (section-11, gate already built).
remaining_phases.P6_reaudit_regenerate: operator fuzzing, exact inverse, canonical-successor normalization, tiny-overfit, regenerate supervision+manifest+caches, warm-start transfer accounting, zero-mixture, no-update throughput; then GO_FULL_RING_SUPPORT_PREFLIGHT / NO_GO_*.

guardrails: No Stage-7 optimizer updates and no final cache compilation until the redesign is implemented + re-audited.
